mandate: C328 — test the cross-sectional intraday VARIANCE-RATIO (RANDOM-WALK-DEVIATION) SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per bar t over W=64 consecutive one-bar returns: Var1=unbiased var of the W returns, Varq=unbiased var of the m=W-q+1 overlapping q-sums, VR(q)=Varq/(q*Var1) (NaN if Var1<=0 or Varq<=0); score=-(VR - trailing same-tod mean_L(VR)). Signals: vr4_dev, vr8_dev, vr16_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and variance-ratio-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: denominators/values<=0 -> NaN; same-tod trailing baseline NaN-aware min_periods=L excluding NaN obs; zero-variance/insufficient-obs NaNs fail-closed (NaN bars weight 0); raw cache fields are zero-NaN real derivations.

data_quality.note: VR NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~max(W,L) bars per bucket) plus Var1/Varq<=0 windows; zero-variance adds negligible mass.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; r2=r^2; r_q4/r_q8/r_q16=log(c[t]/c[t-q]) (0 for t<q, warmup). Zero NaN raw fields.
methodology.signals: per bar t over W=64 consecutive one-bar returns: Var1=unbiased var of r[t-W+1..t], Varq=unbiased var of the m=W-q+1 overlapping q-sums r_q[k] (k in [t-W+q..t]), VR(q)=Varq/(q*Var1) (NaN if Var1<=0 or Varq<=0). score=-(VR - trailing_mean_L(VR@tod)); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs vr_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
